confidence_semantics: publisher/source authority only; not parcel numeric accuracy

candidates.name: Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE)
verified_facts: INSPIRE polygons show the position and indicative extent of registered freehold property.
Each polygon has a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title; polygons crossing local-authority boundaries can appear in multiple files.
semantic_limits: Indicative extent is not an exact legal boundary.
An INSPIRE ID or polygon does not provide terrain elevation.

candidates.name: INSPIRE GML technical guidance
verified_facts: HMLR INSPIRE polygon coordinates are captured against British National Grid.
HMLR warns that reprojection from BNG to WGS84/Web Mercator can shift some features by up to 15 metres.
semantic_limits: Reprojected geometry must not be treated as exact cadastral geometry.
Projection error context is horizontal and not terrain-height uncertainty.

candidates.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons spatial data catalogue
verified_facts: The official catalogue was updated 8 July 2026.
It states local-authority file duplication can occur when polygons cross local-authority boundaries.
semantic_limits: Catalogue freshness is provenance context, not exact boundary evidence.

candidates.name: Search the index map
verified_facts: Index-map searches are used to obtain title numbers or confirm unregistered land.
A plan or Ordnance Survey map reference can be supplied when an address is insufficient.
semantic_limits: Index-map search is title discovery, not exact legal-boundary or terrain evidence.

candidates.name: National Polygon Dataset
verified_facts: The National Polygon Dataset represents freehold and leasehold registration indexing.
The official description states polygon extents are indicative and title plan/register should be consulted for full details.
semantic_limits: Index polygons are not exact target boundaries.

candidates.name: Ordnance Survey coordinate systems
verified_facts: OS distinguishes the National Grid horizontal system from Ordnance Datum Newlyn vertical heights.
OS Net/ETRS89 is used with transformations to access National Grid and ODN today.
semantic_limits: EPSG:27700 horizontal location alone does not define a vertical height datum.

candidates.name: Future of British mapping coordinate systems
verified_facts: OS states OSTN15 and OSGM15 are used to convert ETRS89 GNSS coordinates to OSGB36 and ODN-compatible positions/heights.
semantic_limits: Transformation availability is not a parcel terrain observation.

candidates.name: National Grid Transformation OSTN15
verified_facts: OSTN15 is the definitive OSGB36/ETRS89 transformation and uses a transformation grid with bilinear interpolation.
A simple Helmert transformation is limited to applications requiring roughly metre-scale rather than high-precision transformation.
semantic_limits: Transformation accuracy context must not be substituted for DTM sample accuracy.

candidates.name: National Geoid Model OSGM15
verified_facts: OSGM15 converts ETRS89 ellipsoid height to orthometric height.
On mainland Britain it supplies ODN-compatible orthometric heights; some islands use local vertical datums.
semantic_limits: The correct vertical datum must be matched; geoid model context alone is not a parcel elevation sample.

candidates.name: National Grid and OSGB36 TRF
verified_facts: OSTN15 with OS Net now defines National Grid access.
Published control-point accuracy statistics describe control-network context, not terrain-product accuracy.
semantic_limits: Control-station accuracy is not parcel height uncertainty.

candidates.name: LIDAR Tiles Catalogues FeatureServer
verified_facts: The service exposes DTM and DSM time-stamped extent layers in spatial reference 27700 and supports Query.
semantic_limits: Service/query capability is not proof that a target feature was returned.
A real exact-target response is still required before claiming lineage or NO_DATA.

candidates.name: LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Extents layer
verified_facts: The official layer exposes survey-date, resolution, transform, geoid and polygon identifier fields.
semantic_limits: DSM lineage schema does not permit DSM to substitute for bare-earth DTM.
Schema visibility alone does not prove any target-row match.

verification_basis: official public internet sources checked 2026-07-26; exact target feature/polygon response remains unobserved and fail-closed
